note: ADR 0331 (amended): Archive is rendered by its tag and stored in a closed literal whose only use is a member read `<Dynamic component>` renders, so no use can call it plainly. The tag's createComponent render opens the strict-read window (`observedComponent`, rc.17 solid.dev.js:65), so the body read warns and the checker reports a violation; the Dynamic render alone would not (component-identity-dynamic-map).
requires: Archive rendered by <Archive /> and by <Dynamic component={icons.archive} />
reaches: dev diagnostic STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at Archive's body read
